description: Manually transcribed from the AISHE Final Report 2023-24 (PDF-only source -- see /docs/data-sources.md). GER trend values for 2019-20 through 2023-24 were reconstructed from Figure 64's chart data-label positions (word x/y coordinates), then cross-validated against the report's own prose statements, which independently confirm the 2019-20, 2022-23, and 2023-24 values for every category. The 2014-15 anchor points come directly from prose ('GER has increased by 8.9 points from 18.9', etc).

source_document.table_location: Section 2.3/3.7, Figure 64 (page ~60) and Section 1 headline bullets (page ~19-22)

ger_trend.note: Gross Enrolment Ratio, age 18-23, based on 2011 Census population projection. No OBC GER series is published in this report -- only All/SC/ST.

enrollment_share_latest.note: Category is the student's own reported social category, not their admission category (per report's own clarification). total_enrollment_crore is from the Executive Summary ('Student enrolment reached 4.50 crores', page ~21) -- used to derive a General/Other residual share in scripts/representation/clean.py, since the report does not state a General-category percentage directly.
